title: Cut it in two
goal: This circuit opens already built, and right: out reads a XNOR b, two clocks late. But four gates lie between two of its registers, so its clock can run no faster than a period of 4 ns -- the slowest path from one register to the next, which the TIMING tab shows. Make it run at a period of 2, with out still two clocks late. Its registers start at 0.
hint: a register can move along a path without changing what comes out, so long as every path through it moves alike.
